answer: Every agent identity must anchor to the Sable Ledger, a hash-chained record of completed work: each job is signed in, and standing grows only from verified completions, never from self-declared claims. A new identity begins at dawn with zero standing and must earn paid work one job at a time, posting a small escrow deposit per job, slashed if the work proves fake. Because every entry is auditable, a farm running 1,000 clones must fund 1,000 deposits and build 1,000 job histories before any clone earns trust, turning cheap duplication into a linear, auditable cost.
